SELECT batch_id, event_type, bronze_record_count,
       unique_business_ids, duplicate_delivery_count, reconciliation_status
FROM sentinelpay.pipeline_audit
WHERE batch_id = 'streaming'
  AND event_type = 'payments'

MERGE INTO sentinelpay.pipeline_audit AS t
USING (
  SELECT
    ingest_date,
    batch_id,
    'payments' AS event_type,
    count(*) AS bronze_record_count,
    count(DISTINCT event_id) AS unique_business_ids,
    count(*) - count(DISTINCT event_id) AS duplicate_delivery_count,
    CASE
      WHEN count(DISTINCT event_id) = 0 THEN 'FAIL'
      WHEN count(*) > count(DISTINCT event_id) THEN 'PASS_WITH_DEDUP'
      ELSE 'PASS'
    END AS reconciliation_status,
    CAST(current_timestamp AS varchar) AS evaluated_at
  FROM sentinelpay.payments_bronze
  WHERE ingest_date = '2026-11-04'
    AND batch_id = 'streaming'
  GROUP BY ingest_date, batch_id
) AS s
ON t.ingest_date = s.ingest_date
AND t.batch_id = s.batch_id
AND t.event_type = s.event_type
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  bronze_record_count = s.bronze_record_count,
  unique_business_ids = s.unique_business_ids,
  duplicate_delivery_count = s.duplicate_delivery_count,
  reconciliation_status = s.reconciliation_status,
  evaluated_at = s.evaluated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  ingest_date, batch_id, event_type, bronze_record_count,
  unique_business_ids, duplicate_delivery_count,
  reconciliation_status, evaluated_at
) VALUES (
  s.ingest_date, s.batch_id, s.event_type, s.bronze_record_count,
  s.unique_business_ids, s.duplicate_delivery_count,
  s.reconciliation_status, s.evaluated_at
)

       unique_business_ids, duplicate_delivery_count, reconciliation_status
FROM sentinelpay.pipeline_audit
ORDER BY batch_id, event_type

MERGE INTO sentinelpay.pipeline_audit AS t
USING (
  SELECT
    ingest_date,
    batch_id,
    event_type,
    record_count AS bronze_record_count,
    unique_ids AS unique_business_ids,
    record_count - unique_ids AS duplicate_delivery_count,
    CASE
      WHEN unique_ids = 0 THEN 'FAIL'
      WHEN record_count > unique_ids THEN 'PASS_WITH_DEDUP'
      ELSE 'PASS'
    END AS reconciliation_status,
    CAST(current_timestamp AS varchar) AS evaluated_at
  FROM (
    SELECT ingest_date, batch_id, 'payments' AS event_type,
           count(*) AS record_count, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS unique_ids
    FROM sentinelpay.payments_bronze
    GROUP BY ingest_date, batch_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ingest_date, batch_id, 'feature_updates',
           count(*), count(DISTINCT feature_event_id)
    FROM sentinelpay.feature_updates_bronze
    GROUP BY ingest_date, batch_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ingest_date, batch_id, 'fraud_decisions',
           count(*), count(DISTINCT decision_id)
    FROM sentinelpay.fraud_decisions_bronze
    GROUP BY ingest_date, batch_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ingest_date, batch_id, 'chargeback_outcomes',
           count(*), count(DISTINCT outcome_event_id)
    FROM sentinelpay.chargeback_outcomes_bronze
    GROUP BY ingest_date, batch_id
  )
) AS s
ON t.ingest_date = s.ingest_date
AND t.batch_id = s.batch_id
AND t.event_type = s.event_type
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  bronze_record_count = s.bronze_record_count,
  unique_business_ids = s.unique_business_ids,
  duplicate_delivery_count = s.duplicate_delivery_count,
  reconciliation_status = s.reconciliation_status,
  evaluated_at = s.evaluated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  ingest_date, batch_id, event_type, bronze_record_count,
  unique_business_ids, duplicate_delivery_count,
  reconciliation_status, evaluated_at
) VALUES (
  s.ingest_date, s.batch_id, s.event_type, s.bronze_record_count,
  s.unique_business_ids, s.duplicate_delivery_count,
  s.reconciliation_status, s.evaluated_at
)

       min(event_date) AS first_event_date,
       max(event_date) AS last_event_date

MERGE INTO sentinelpay.training_examples_gold AS t
USING (
  SELECT
    data_classification,
    'v1' AS dataset_version,
    payment_id,
    event_id,
    CAST(substr(event_time, 1, 10) AS date) AS event_date,
    event_time,
    received_at,
    amount,
    currency,
    channel,
    country_code,
    device_first_seen_days,
    transaction_count AS transaction_count_1h,
    amount_sum AS amount_sum_1h,
    distinct_merchant_count AS distinct_merchant_count_1h,
    new_device_count AS new_device_count_1h,
    feature_computed_at,
    label,
    CASE WHEN label = 'CONFIRMED_FRAUD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label_fraud,
    label_observed_at,
    date_diff(
      'day',
      from_iso8601_timestamp(event_time),
      from_iso8601_timestamp(label_observed_at)
    ) AS label_delay_days,
    label_source
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.data_classification,
      p.payment_id,
      p.event_id,
      p.event_time,
      p.received_at,
      p.amount,
      p.currency,
      p.channel,
      p.country_code,
      p.device_first_seen_days,
      f.transaction_count,
      f.amount_sum,
      f.distinct_merchant_count,
      f.new_device_count,
      f.computed_at AS feature_computed_at,
      o.outcome AS label,
      o.label_observed_at,
      o.outcome_source AS label_source,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.payment_id
        ORDER BY
          from_iso8601_timestamp(f.window_end) DESC,
          from_iso8601_timestamp(f.computed_at) DESC,
          f.feature_event_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM sentinelpay.payments_iceberg p
    JOIN sentinelpay.chargeback_outcomes_iceberg o
      ON o.payment_id = p.payment_id
     AND o.outcome_source = 'SYNTHETIC_LABEL_GENERATOR'
     AND from_iso8601_timestamp(o.label_observed_at) >=
         date_add('day', 30, from_iso8601_timestamp(p.event_time))
    JOIN sentinelpay.fraud_decisions_iceberg d
      ON d.event_id = p.event_id
    JOIN sentinelpay.feature_updates_iceberg f
      ON f.entity_type = 'ACCOUNT'
     AND f.entity_token = p.account_token
     AND f.currency = p.currency
     AND from_iso8601_timestamp(f.window_end) <= from_iso8601_timestamp(p.event_time)
     AND from_iso8601_timestamp(f.computed_at) <= from_iso8601_timestamp(d.decision_time)
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) AS s
ON t.payment_id = s.payment_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  data_classification = s.data_classification,
  dataset_version = s.dataset_version,
  event_id = s.event_id,
  event_date = s.event_date,
  event_time = s.event_time,
  received_at = s.received_at,
  amount = s.amount,
  currency = s.currency,
  channel = s.channel,
  country_code = s.country_code,
  device_first_seen_days = s.device_first_seen_days,
  transaction_count_1h = s.transaction_count_1h,
  amount_sum_1h = s.amount_sum_1h,
  distinct_merchant_count_1h = s.distinct_merchant_count_1h,
  new_device_count_1h = s.new_device_count_1h,
  feature_computed_at = s.feature_computed_at,
  label = s.label,
  label_fraud = s.label_fraud,
  label_observed_at = s.label_observed_at,
  label_delay_days = s.label_delay_days,
  label_source = s.label_source
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  data_classification, dataset_version, payment_id, event_id, event_date,
  event_time, received_at, amount, currency, channel, country_code,
  device_first_seen_days, transaction_count_1h, amount_sum_1h,
  distinct_merchant_count_1h, new_device_count_1h, feature_computed_at,
  label, label_fraud, label_observed_at, label_delay_days, label_source
) VALUES (
  s.data_classification, s.dataset_version, s.payment_id, s.event_id, s.event_date,
  s.event_time, s.received_at, s.amount, s.currency, s.channel, s.country_code,
  s.device_first_seen_days, s.transaction_count_1h, s.amount_sum_1h,
  s.distinct_merchant_count_1h, s.new_device_count_1h, s.feature_computed_at,
  s.label, s.label_fraud, s.label_observed_at, s.label_delay_days, s.label_source
)
